dct_creator_sm: Meyer, David (University of Toronto). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0979-118X
dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains pressure measurements taken in Zones "A" and "B" during the pilot study described in the associated paper. Sampling location codes correspond to figures in the supplemental information. Two versions of the pressure data are included here: all pressure data recorded while water was supplied and only data from when while water was supplied between 5 AM and 9:05 AM, the typical supply window. 
Results from water quality grab sampling are also included.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Effects of hydraulically disconnecting consumer pumps in an intermittent water supply
